notablePrerequisites: Kwain and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken and Drogskol Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Drogskol Reaver trigger, causing you to draw a card, triggering Tolarian Kraken.
Resolve both Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Palladium Myr and Kwain.
Repeat.
